name: intake
description: Reads a client email, text message, Fathom or phone call, works out what Macallan has to do about it, matches that work to the live service catalog, routes it to the right teams, and files it as an inbound communication with suggested tasks for someone to review. Reads a signed SOW and builds the draft project it describes, with every task staged for a person to push.

connector_url.title: MCP connection URL
connector_url.description: From Configuration -> Integrations in Macallan Onboarding: https://<your-app>/api/connector/<token>. The token is shown once, when the connection is created. It needs the read and write scopes.
